landing_title: From recording to reviewed meeting minutes
landing_intro: Upload audio, get a timestamped transcript, check action items and deadlines against the recording, then download a PDF or DOCX.
landing_sample_note: This example illustrates the interface. A person must review results from a real recording.
landing_sample_line: Prepare a budget draft before the next meeting.
landing_secretary: For the secretary: less retyping — check each action beside its source line, owner and original deadline wording.
landing_manager: For the manager: actions live in one reviewed document; unknown details stay unknown.
landing_flow_intro: First the recording and transcript, then human review. Export opens only after the revision is approved.
landing_speakers_note: Voice labels are anonymous. A person confirms names; the public demo flow is still under validation.
landing_trust_auth: Meetings and recordings are available to their owner after sign-in.
landing_trust_local: Audio recognition runs locally; Russian, Kazakh and mixed-speech quality still needs checking.
landing_trust_review: Actions and deadlines can be corrected by hand. A draft never approves itself.
landing_trust_note: A new full run on CPU can take around 15 minutes or longer. Automatic drafts and speakers are still being accepted.
landing_cta_title: See the path in the real app
landing_cta_intro: Start with your own recording or open the demo guide. Use synthetic or anonymized data when presenting.
a11y_speech_help: Read aloud requires a local voice for the selected language. Text stays on your device.
a11y_speech_unavailable: Read aloud is unavailable in this browser.
home_description: Meeting transcripts, action items and summaries in one workspace.
home_status: Recording processing is not connected yet.

player_server_help: Choose a meeting recording. Audio and its transcript load from protected storage after sign-in.
player_no_server_recordings: There are no ready recordings with media in your meetings yet.

player_server_transcript_error: Could not load the recording transcript. Refresh the page and check your access.
player_server_transcript_missing: This recording has no completed transcript result yet.
player_server_transcript_empty: The result has no timed transcript segments.
player_summary_error: Could not load the summary. Refresh the page.
player_summary_empty: No summary is available for this recording yet.
player_workflow_help: Create a meeting, upload a recording, run transcription, and review the result here.
transcript_follow_on: Following the current segment. Scroll the text to pause following.
transcript_follow_off: Following is off. Enable it to return to the current segment.
transcript_empty: No timed segments for this recording and result version.
capture_description: Only audio you select is recorded. This does not join Teams, Meet or Zoom as a separate participant.
capture_guide_title: How to record an online meeting
capture_guide_intro: Open the meeting on this computer and tell participants about the recording. Then return here to capture its audio.
capture_guide_meet: Google Meet: open the meeting in a separate browser tab.
capture_guide_teams: Microsoft Teams: open the meeting in the web app in a separate browser tab.
capture_guide_zoom: Zoom: open the meeting in its web client in a separate tab. For the Zoom desktop app, choose system audio if your browser offers it.
capture_guide_step_one: Select ‘Selected tab / system audio’, or ‘Microphone and shared audio’ if you also need your voice.
capture_guide_step_two: Select ‘Start recording’, choose the meeting tab, and enable audio sharing in the browser picker. Check that the audio meter moves.
capture_guide_step_three: After the meeting, select ‘Stop’ and ‘Save on server’. Open the saved meeting and start processing.
capture_guide_limit: Automatic bot joining for Meet, Teams, and Zoom is not available yet. Tab and system audio capture depend on your browser and OS.
capture_transport_disconnected: After stopping, save the recording on the server. You can start processing from the saved meeting.
capture_save_error: Could not save the recording. Check your connection and retry; download the local copy before leaving this page.
capture_save_auth_error: Your session expired or access was denied. Sign in again in another tab and retry; download the local copy before leaving.
capture_save_rejected_error: The server rejected the recording or a chunk. Download the local copy; retrying may not resolve the error.
capture_save_resume: Retry sends the same chunks to the same recording.
capture_browser_help: HTTPS or localhost is required. Select a source in the browser picker and enable audio sharing. Tab, window and system audio availability depends on your browser and OS; recording cannot start without an audio track. Video is not recorded. Use headphones when mixing sources.
capture_notice: I have permission to record and have notified participants about recording and potential local / self-hosted AI transcription.
capture_silence: No signal or source temporarily muted. Check the selected audio.
capture_error_unsupported: This browser does not support the required capture or format. Use a current browser on HTTPS / localhost.
capture_error_permission: Permission denied or selection cancelled. Allow access and try again.
capture_error_no_audio: The selected source provided no audio track. Enable audio sharing or select the microphone.
capture_error_source_lost: The source stopped. The retained recording is marked incomplete.
capture_error_limit: Local recording limit reached. The continuous prefix was retained; the recording is incomplete.
capture_error_device: Device or recording error. Check permissions and the source; retained audio may be incomplete.
capture_local_result: Listen and download before leaving this page. Closing or refreshing the page loses the recording.
capture_playback_error: The browser could not play this recording. Download the file; an incomplete container may need server recovery.
capture_limits: Local mode: up to 30 minutes, 64 MiB and 4096 chunks. Recording continues locally if the network drops. Changing source requires a new recording.
workspace_intro: Recording → transcript → human review → minutes. Your account stores the results.
workspace_empty_meetings: Create your first meeting to upload a recording.
workspace_empty_participants: No participants yet. An assignee can remain unknown.
workspace_upload_help: Up to 512 MiB. The file is processed on our server.
workspace_empty_recordings: Upload a recording for this meeting.
workspace_incomplete: Recording is incomplete. Results cover only the available part.
workspace_failed: Processing failed. You can try again.
workspace_interrupted: Processing was interrupted. You can try again.
workspace_unavailable: The transcription model is not available on this server yet.
workspace_manual_notice: Summary and actions are entered by a person. Automatic extraction and speaker identification are not available yet.
workspace_no_results: No saved results yet. Start transcription.
workspace_empty_transcript: This version contains no recognized segments.
workspace_due_help: Leave unknown or event-based deadlines undated. The speaker is not necessarily the assignee.
workspace_sources_help: Choose segments from the loaded transcript. No selection means a manual note without a confirmed source.
workspace_approve: I checked the content and approve these minutes
workspace_reload_help: Reloading replaces unsaved fields with the saved version.
workspace_conflict: Another session saved a newer revision. Your fields remain on screen. Load the latest version and reconcile your edits.
workspace_export_help: Save with explicit approval first. Downloads use the selected saved revision.
workspace_request_failed: Request failed. Check your connection and try again.
workspace_invalid: Check the fields, sources and assignees.
workspace_no_access: This item is no longer available. Refresh the list.
workspace_file_limit: Choose a nonempty file up to 512 MiB.
workspace_source_list_limit: Load more transcript segments above to choose additional sources.
